invented_speech: Explicitly requested invented speech: compose the spoken words; label each vocal event with the source's stable (Sx) ID. Reuse the same ID for every later utterance by that source.
missing_utterances: Preserved dialogue requested but no authoritative utterances supplied; do not invent text to fill this gap.
speech_header: Authoritative user dialogue, in playback order (verbatim words):
shared_line: Shared line {shared_line}: this actor speaks the complete words.
shared_simultaneous: Deliver in unison with the other actors of this shared line, not as a reply.
shared_coordination: Preserve the user/Analyst coordination with the other actors of this shared line.
language_placeholder: (replace the language placeholder with the real language).
speech_omission_rule: Never replace a spoken event with 'speaks the line' or a description of speaking. Shared simultaneous events must each have a tag and distinct source ID, without implying a sequential exchange.
speech_final_rule: Emit EVERY event once and in order as a separate <d>[Language] words</d>; put every event in detailed_description, at its actual speech beat, with its specified Subject and (Sx). Event numbers are NOT speaker numbers: reuse the assigned source ID exactly. The summary never satisfies this contract; keep the quoted words byte-for-byte.
fallback: Use the normalized reference_contract and stable speaker IDs assigned to distinct vocal sources.
optional_environment_subject: Optional offscreen environment <Subject {subject}> / <Picture {picture}>: do not force a detailed_description citation or wider framing; if defined, preserve the correct Picture binding.
unresolved_character: UNRESOLVED character reference <Picture {picture}>: do not silently discard it; the user must identify the existing Subject owner (or re-analyze).
visible_environment_picture: detailed_description cites <Picture {picture}> as the visible environment (no Subject).
offscreen_picture: Offscreen <Picture {picture}> is scene memory, not a required visible citation.
keyframe_present: A concrete end keyframe is present; use task types accordingly.
keyframe_absent: No end keyframe: omit 'keyframe completion' from task prefix.
unresolved_collective: UNRESOLVED collective speaker attribution: {speakers}. Preserve the words; do not guess a reference binding.
unresolved_event: UNRESOLVED speaker attribution for user quote(s): {events}. Do not omit or guess the words; refresh Analyst if needed.
